framework: Method A Original Framework (Deterministic Reference Implementation)

provenance_verification.reason: Deterministic regeneration by Abaqus 2023 advancing-front remesher from identical coarse seed and identical PK_HOLE_METHOD_A_PREANALYSIS.odb source. PK_HOLE_ORIG_METHOD_A_PROD_PHYS.inp and PK_HOLE_METHOD_A_PROD_PHYS.inp have identical element connectivity and node coordinates across all 93,526 lines, differing solely on Line 2 Job-name comment. It is NOT a distinct or improved mesh.

indicator_correlation.note: Raw MISESERI is an element stress error norm in stress units (kN/mm^2). RemeshingRule errorTarget=2.0% is a global percentage relative error norm. Correlation confirms monotonic association between error indicator and refinement, but raw MISESERI is not a percentage error.

scientific_diagnosis: The native Method A reference remesher is deterministic and mathematically consistent with Abaqus UNIFORM_ERROR logic. However, because linear elastic continuum preanalysis induces non-localized, slowly decaying stress error norms throughout the plate (median raw MISESERI = 8.54 kN/mm^2), UNIFORM_ERROR refines 90.5% of the outer domain below 10 um (median h_max = 7.3 um). This inflates the mesh to 46,747 elements while only 23.4% of notch tip elements achieve longest edge h_max <= 1.5 um. This establishes reproducible evidence that pure continuum MISESERI preanalysis cannot achieve spatial selectivity for phase-field fracture localization without damage-informed spatial bounding.
